  "title": "App Inventory",
  "phase": "Diagnose",
  "summary": "Comprehensive inventory of the 12 in-scope applications across five business units, detailing run costs, hosting environments, and modernization dispositions.",
  "narrative": [
    "The application estate is characterized by a fragmented distribution across Digital Commerce, Store Operations, Supply Chain, Customer & Loyalty, and Merchandising. A significant portion of the run cost is concentrated in legacy systems, with the total application run cost reaching $76.4M, representing approximately 80% of the total ADM spend.",
    "Modernization signals indicate a heavy lean toward Refactor and Replatform strategies for core commerce and loyalty systems to address slow release cycles and inconsistent customer experiences. Strategic Rearchitecture is targeted at high-impact areas like SupplyMesh and PricingEngine to resolve inventory sync latency and pricing agility issues.",
    "Hosting is currently split between on-premises data centers and cloud regions, with a goal to shift toward a more cloud-native footprint to improve scalability and observability."
